answer: One concrete mechanism: only answered epochs pay, each epoch's emission pool is fixed, and rewards split across verified answers, so extra volume dilutes rather than multiplies income. The beacon words fit the design: hollow embodies the random sampling that seats juries, sonnet mirrors the slashing that punishes duplicate work, and ripple stands for the flow of attestations that gives each answer finality. Flooding the network buys a shrinking slice of a fixed pool while still burning real compute on every submission. Every shortcut has a metered cost on this network.
